title: Smoked Irish Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make wrap with smoked Irish sausage, lettuce, and lightly smoked flavors.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Add the Irish Smoked Sausage and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through.
3. Meanwhile, cook the Lightly Smoked Bacon in a separate pan until crispy.
4. Assemble the wraps by adding the cooked sausage, shredded lettuce, and Lightly Smoked Cheddar Cheese.
5. Top with cooked bacon and serve immediately.
6. Serve with additional toppings as desired.
